title: A Primer of the Throwing Arm
summary: Teaches a new crew hand the parts of a catapult and how to stand clear while the arm swings.

title: Handbook of the Catapult Crew Round
summary: Sets out the calls and stations of a catapult crew so winder and loader and puller work as one.

title: Workbook of the Windlass Crank
summary: Builds the back and leg strength to wind a catapult windlass by body alone without losing the rope.

title: Drill-Book of Stone Shaping and Loading
summary: Shows how to dress throwing stones and lift them into the cup safely with body strength alone.

title: Treatise on Pawl and Ratchet Keeping
summary: Teaches the care of the catch that holds a wound arm and the watch kept over it.

title: A Primer of Qi-Eased Winding
summary: Teaches a Senior who circulates qi to ease the crank and read the rope without tiring.

title: Handbook of the Sling Cup Release
summary: Covers folding the pouch and timing the release so the stone leaves the cup at the top of the swing.

title: Workbook of the Ranging Stake Line
summary: Trains a Senior to lay a stake line and correct a short or wide shot one tooth at a time.

title: Plain Canon of the Catapult Bed
summary: Explains how to level and bed a catapult frame so it does not creep or rock under repeated shots.

title: Drill-Book of the Skein Tension Check
summary: Teaches a Senior to test twisted rope skeins by touch and sound and to keep both sides matched.
